_comment: Tunable gameplay numbers. Designers own this file. Change a number, refresh the browser.
_ramp: Everything with fromYear unlocks when the kid reaches that year. Stations ramp in house.json.

player._movement: 'snappy' = instant start/stop. 'floaty' = accelerate and drift (uses acceleration + drag).
player._controls: Mouse: left button = left hand, right button = right hand; press = grab, release in place = drop, move-then-release = throw to cursor. Keyboard: Q/J grab-drop, E/L throw.

round._comment: One round = one year of the kid's life.

baby._comment: Who the kid is each year is in `phases` (first phase whose fromYear <= year). Shared numbers below.
baby._attention: Need for attention rises from 0 to 1 over `attentionSeconds` while not held. Colour goes green → yellow → red. Pick up = reset to 0. Walking within patRadius = minus patRelief, once per patCooldownSeconds. At 1 (red) the phase's `trouble` happens.

phases.name: toddler
phases._trouble: hazard = wanders; when red, heads for the nearest hazard and cries on arrival.

phases.name: kid
phases._trouble: antics = runs around; when red, climbs and jumps off something climbable (cries) or tips the bin (trash everywhere, cries).

baby._combos: Baby in one hand + warm bottle in the other feeds over feedSeconds while you walk. Baby + clean diaper changes over changeSeconds.
baby._cry: Cry level rises while any baby need is unmet, the kid is at a hazard, or is in trouble; falls otherwise. Crying costs score per second.

mess._comment: Mess on the floor costs perItemPerSecond. Clothes and trash start appearing from their fromYear.

throw._comment: Mouse: hold a hand's button, move the cursor, release = throw to the cursor. Keyboard E/L throws `distance` the way you're facing. Lands in a container that accepts it = put away. Hits the baby = crying + a soothe demand. Hits a hazard = penalty. Two-handed items and the baby can't be thrown.

demands._comment: Tickets. 'every' = seconds between spawns of that type (jittered). 'timer' = seconds before it expires. 'first' = seconds until the first one. 'fromYear' = when this demand starts existing.

soothe.label: Soothe
soothe._note: Also spawned whenever the kid cries from neglect.

scoring._comment: Stars for the year from completion rate. The kid's next year (and the next generation) will be built on this.
